entries.description: A published design-time Agent Skill for investigating agent-proposed MERGE, SPLIT, UNMERGE and supported identity-changing operations, then producing reviewable recommendations and structured engineering plans. It does not execute mutations or authorize production writes.

Public, stateless, read-only MCP Streamable HTTP service exposing the DIO/ODI Reference Model, canonical SKOS vocabulary, and selected derived Agentic ER and Policy-as-Code reference mappings. It does not inspect integrating applications, validate evidence, authorize mutations, or execute production writes.
